intent: I have genuinely huge hands, and after long sessions my right thumb and forearm ache enough that I've started skipping game nights with friends. My physio muttered something about grip size and strain but couldn't name a product. Standard pads feel like I'm pinching a bar of soap. Is there real science behind controller shape and hand size, or is 'ergonomic' just a word printed on the box? Which controllers do other big-handed players end up sticking with long-term, and do those clip-on grip extenders actually help? Tell me what you'd get in my situation.
